# ${module_id} - Practical or external validation

## Module contract and selection

@@SELECTION@@

Own one real authorized attempt from admission through observation, result, stop, cleanup, and durable
closure. Bundle checkpoint/resume and observation because they are part of controlling the same attempt.

## Public interface and compatibility boundary

ROOT-authorized real attempt + exact target/readiness -> correlated observations, terminal state and cleanup. Concrete values and return targets belong to the owning step's configured instance. Private changes do not alter public semantics; update actual consumers for a real contract change.

## Rules, process, recipe actions, and allowed variations

P01–P15 own shared rules. Semantic choices in recipe verbs remain ROOT decisions; test_root only authors declared lane-local contracts. Workers mechanically execute supplied choices and return any missing meaning. Reviewer findings remain open within assigned boundaries. Each governing card cites all actions; member cards cite only their ordered subset. Parameters may select bounded source/test paths and optional profiles, never weaken acceptance or change authority.

| Order | Recipe action ID | Project-specific action/process | Allowed parameterization | Decision owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | M09-A1 | Verify authorization, target/resource ID, prerequisite product coordinate, readiness result, and absence of conflicting claims before allocation. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 2 | M09-A2 | Create one retained attempt ID and bind controller, process/worker IDs, observer, result roots, and cleanup owner. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 3 | M09-A3 | Launch only the predeclared topology. Serialize shared real resources; parallelize only isolated work. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 4 | M09-A4 | Start independent observation before the behavior it must observe. Observation is read-only unless its exact containment authority is triggered. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 5 | M09-A5 | Execute the real scenario, record commands/actions, timings, outputs, target state, and failures. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 6 | M09-A6 | On interruption, checkpoint the semantic task plus session/worktree/resource IDs and each completed practical check unit's consumed target/resource state. Reuse a unit only when that state remains verified unchanged; otherwise close safely and start only the affected declared work. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 7 | M09-A7 | Stop/abort immediately only for an R23 observation; preserve what diagnosis/recovery needs and contain identified descendants/resources. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 8 | M09-A8 | Reach terminal state, stop cooperatively, verify cleanup by process/resource IDs, and retain required result/observer/cleanup information even on failure. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |
| 9 | M09-A9 | Join real-attempt results once and send them to M05. Do not repair product inside a live attempt. | owning instance exact paths, proof goals, predecessor output and selected scope | root |

- Product/practical failure closes the attempt safely, then goes to M05 classification.
- Support/observer/report failure isolates only affected claims unless the real outcome becomes unknowable;
  every practical claim not consuming that result remains decidable and advances.
- Authorization or target mismatch stops before allocation and reports `INCOMPLETE` or contradiction.
- Cleanup uncertainty leaves the attempt terminal-but-visible and blocks resource reuse, not unrelated product credit.
